id.description:
Unique identifier for the filter item.
Used to track selection state and identify the item in the filter hierarchy.

name.description:
Display name for the filter item.
The text that will be shown to users in the filter interface.

children.description:
Child filter items that belong to this item.
Allows for hierarchical organization of filter options.

title:
Type definition for an individual filter item in the GraphFilter component.
Represents a hierarchical structure where each item can have child items.
name: GraphFilterItem
